skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Find an LCD for unlike denominators and convert fractions or fractional parts to equivalent fractions with that common denominator.

skills.name: Subtract and simplify fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions once they have a common denominator by subtracting numerators, keeping the denominator, and reducing the result to lowest terms when needed.

skills.name: Subtract mixed or whole numbers without regrouping
skills.definition: Separate whole-number and fractional parts, subtract or carry the whole and fractional parts when no borrowing is needed, and combine the result.

skills.name: Regroup in mixed or whole subtraction
skills.definition: When the fractional subtraction would be negative, borrow one or more whole units, convert each borrowed unit to denominator-over-denominator form, adjust the whole part, and combine the result.
